messages:
Mira (Acme): Hey team, our rollout dashboard for exp_2026_featureX suddenly shows 96% of users in 'control' and 4% in 'treatment' for the 09:00-10:00 UTC window. Our assignment logs are ~50/50. Screenshot: https://acme.screenshots/xyz789
Meera: @Mira can you paste the exact rollout id and a couple of user_ids that are showing incorrectly? Also did this start right after the mapping deploy?
Mira (Acme): rollout=exp_2026_featureX. Sample users: acme|u_7721, acme|u_1183. It looks bad right after the migration about 08:55 UTC. When I call the /assign API I get variant 'baseline' but the dashboard places the same user in 'control'.
Chris: I'm looking at ingestion. We have a mapping change deployed at 08:54 that maps old keys to new keys: baseline -> control, treatment_v2 -> treatment. The assignments-store writes normalized variant_key into analytics.assignments, but analytics-agg was using a cached mapping from before the deploy — looks like cache invalidation failed.
ops-bot: ALERT mapping-cache-invalidate failed for svc=analytics-agg at 08:54:12 | recent-deploy=mapping-v2
Jamie: To reproduce: 1) query raw.events for exp_2026_featureX in the 09:00 window, 2) query analytics.assignments for same window, 3) compare distinct user counts. If mapping got applied twice (once at ingestion, once at aggregation) counts will shift.
Chris: Repro SQLs I ran: 
```
-- raw events
SELECT variant, count(distinct user) FROM raw.events WHERE exp='exp_2026_featureX' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-16 09:00' AND '2026-03-16 10:00' GROUP BY variant;
-- analytics agg
SELECT variant_key, count(distinct user_id) FROM analytics.assignments WHERE exp_id='exp_2026_featureX' AND ts >= '2026-03-16 09:00' GROUP BY variant_key;
```
Raw: baseline 49,800; treatment_v2 50,200
Analytics: control 99,900; treatment 1000
Meera: That explains the ~100x skew. Looks like analytics-agg applied mapping to events that already had mapping applied by assignments-store, doubling the translation: baseline -> control (ok) but also combining baseline+control totals.
Mira (Acme): Customer sees the analytics chart and is escalating. They rely on the dashboard numbers. What's the quick mitigation?
Jamie: Short-term options: A) Backfill analytics.assignments for the affected time range using raw.variant (undo the extra mapping) B) Roll back mapping in analytics-agg to the previous cached mapping C) Pause dashboard cache refresh for that experiment while we fix. I recommend A + C.
Chris: Kicking off backfill job with SQL that overwrites analytics.assignments rows for 08:50-10:30 for exp_2026_featureX using raw.variant as canonical. Job id bf-20260316-02. ETA ~15m. Also invalidated analytics-agg mapping cache manually.
ops-bot: job_update: bf-20260316-02 status=running nodes=3
Meera: Support repro steps for our team: 1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/assign -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"user_id":"acme|u_7721","exp_id":"exp_2026_featureX"}' and note response.variant and response.variant_key; 2) grep the app server logs for the same user to see raw.event variant field; 3) run the SQLs above and compare counts; 4) verify dashboard after cache invalidation.
Mira (Acme): Thanks. Please keep us updated, customer is awaiting a corrected chart.
Chris: Backfill finished: bf-20260316-02 status=success rows_updated=100200. Cache invalidated.
ops-bot: mapping-cache invalidate confirmed for analytics-agg at 09:25:41
Jamie: Dashboard refresh triggered and sanity checks now enabled: we added a one-time alert that compares analytics.assignments distribution vs raw.events distribution and will fire if any variant distribution changes by >20% for the last 24h. Also added a pre-deploy mapping-test to CI that validates mapping idempotency.
Mira (Acme): Chart shows ~49%/51% now. Customer satisfied for now. Filing an incident report on our side.
Meera: Postmortem items: (1) ensure mapping config is single source of truth and updates are atomic, (2) add automated cache invalidation to deploy pipeline, (3) add a dashboard-level check that flags sudden spikes in a variant's share, (4) instrument a distributed trace tag for mapping-version on assignment events.
Mira (Acme): Appreciate the quick turnaround. Closing for now.
